# Launch kit — v3.4.7 (2026-11-27)

**Reader:** a developer already using an AI coding agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI) who is tired of re-explaining their codebase.
**One action:** install with `npx musememory connect`.
**Source facts:** 3.4.7 release; 52 detected agents; 1,885 tests; sub-2ms recall; MIT; nine typed read tools. All numbers come from `claims.json` via the site, not from memory.

## X / Twitter thread

**1/**
Your coding agent forgets everything when the session ends.

Muse Memory saves what it learns to plain files on your machine, then hands the right notes back next time.

No cloud. No daemon. One command.

v3.4.7 is out → https://github.com/harshsinghmp/musememory/releases/tag/v3.4.7

**2/**
Most agent memory is a flat file that grows until it becomes noise.

Muse checks a note's citation before it stores it, then withholds notes whose code has drifted — instead of serving them as current.

**3/**
New in v3.4.7:

• nine read tools return typed structuredContent
• a gate that stops stale test counts from shipping
• a rebuilt site where every number comes from the code

All local, MIT, no account.

**4/**
Install:

    npx musememory connect

52 agents detected and wired over MCP. 1,885 tests. sub-2ms recall.

If you use Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or Gemini CLI, this is the notebook your agent is missing.

## LinkedIn

A coding agent without memory re-learns your codebase every session.

Muse Memory keeps what the agent learns in plain YAML + SQLite on your machine, verifies every citation at write time, and withholds notes whose code has moved on. One command wires 52 agents over MCP. Nothing runs in the background and nothing leaves the machine.

v3.4.7 ships typed results for nine read tools, a stricter release gate, and a rebuilt site where every published number is generated from the code.

MIT. No account. https://github.com/harshsinghmp/musememory/releases/tag/v3.4.7

*Image: `post-1080.png`.*

## Notes for the poster

- One CTA per post. Do not add a second link.
- Do not say "revolutionary", "seamless" or "world-class"; the proof is the behaviour.
- The release URL is the only link; the install line is the only command.
- Post the 1:1 asset, not the OG card — OG is for link previews.
